# Nexify Examina — Online Examination & AI Proctoring Platform
> Enterprise online examination, computer-based testing (CBT), and AI proctoring SaaS for colleges, universities, and schools in India.

## Organization Information
- Name: Nexify Examina
- Parent Entity: Nexify Forge
- Founder & Chief Architect: Pawan Kumar Yadav
- Headquarters: Mohali, Punjab, India
- Website: https://exam.nexifyforge.in/
- Official Support & Inquiries: support@nexifyforge.in | exam@nexifyforge.in
- Category: Educational Technology, Assessment Software, AI Invigilation

## Core Capabilities
- Zero-Download Browser Lockdown: Fullscreen kiosk mode, tab-switch prevention, clipboard disabled, shortcut blocking without desktop .exe or browser extensions.
- Multi-Language In-Browser Coding Compiler: Sandboxed code execution for Python 3, Java, C++, and JavaScript with hidden test-case validation for engineering college placement and lab practicals.
- 6-Layer AI Proctoring: Continuous neural face presence, gaze and head-pose estimation, multiple faces detection, acoustic whisper detection, and court-admissible audit dossiers.
- High-Concurrency Cluster: Distributed 16-node least-connection microservices cluster load-tested for 2,000+ simultaneous students per college with zero lag, instant Redis answer buffering, and PostgreSQL 18 persistence.
- Multi-Department College Governance: Automated student roster onboarding via Excel/CSV, question paper randomization, section timers, and instant scorecard generation.

## Supported Assessment Formats
- Multiple Choice Questions (Single and Multi-Select MCQs)
- Subjective & Descriptive Long-Form Questions
- Multi-Language Algorithmic Coding Problems (Python, Java, C++, JS)
- Aptitude, Reasoning & Domain Knowledge Tests
- Negative Marking (+4, -1, 0) for JEE/NEET/Competitive Test Series

## Privacy & Security Standards
- Zero kernel-level drivers required on student devices.
- Webcam and audio tracking active strictly during approved examination windows.
- Role-based access controls separating Student, College Admin, and Super Admin spaces.
- Encrypted student answer buffers in Redis and PostgreSQL.
